searchText: Can someone remind me (or point to any document) what is the future of these testnets? - Ropsten - Rinkeby - Kovan https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/06/21/testnet-deprecation/ Looks good, thanks. CL call in ~20.5 hours https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/594 I've asked in a couple venues but I don't think I got a definitive response: what should we do w/ our existing Goerli Clique validator once the merge completes? Shut it down? If so, should we wait until X epochs/slots/blocks later "just in case"? Keeping it online shouldn't stop the Merge from happening. If you are running older software that does not have the TTD then it may stay producing blocks, not sure what you run. I'd be interested in how many peers it retains after the upgrade. Many testnet users probably forget to update / prepare for Merge. Ya it's running a pre-TTD version, but I could definitely upgrade it to latest if that'd help (sans CL I assume) the Merge go smoother. <dannyryan> nah, it's interesting to see someone try to make blocks after. I'd just leave it running for some amount of time and turn if off after (either a few epochs or a few days. shouldn't matter either way) 👍 I suspect most of the other Clique validators are in a similar state so us upgrading at the last minute probably wouldn't sway the outcome much anyways actually looks like the out-of-date ones (based on https://stats.goerli.net are our infura node, prylabs, and Ronin's OpenEthereum one). So anyways please ping me if for some reason we need to upgrade (I'll probably be watching it during the merge but just in case).
